name: @hheei/omp-mctx
description: OMP Window owner: Magic Context compaction, compartments, ctx_reduce/expand/note, and the agentmemory bridge.

scripts.test: bun test src/host src/agentmemory test/agentmemory src/agentmemory-foundation.test.ts src/core/shared/data-path.ts src/core/features/fresh-schema.test.ts src/core/features/context-projection.test.ts src/core/features/context-projection-coordinator.test.ts src/core/features/fail-closed-block.test.ts src/core/features/memory/embedding-local.test.ts src/core/features/memory/embedding-openai-failure.test.ts src/core/hooks/empty-task-output.test.ts src/core/hooks/temporal-awareness.test.ts src/core/hooks/strip-content.test.ts src/core/hooks/format-embed-failure.test.ts src/core/agents/magic-context-prompt.test.ts src/commands/ctx-embed-partial.test.ts src/config/config.test.ts src/core/hooks/lkg-persist.test.ts src/core/hooks/raw-fallback-context-limit.test.ts src/lkg-pi.test.ts

enabled.description: Leave off on the daily OMP until Durable Memory is unregistered (ADR-0001).

searchEnabled.description: Register ctx_search for session-history retrieval. Disable to remove it from the agent tool surface.

noteEnabled.description: Register ctx_note and session-note nudges. Disable to remove both.

historianEnabled.description: Allow historian compaction runs when historianModel is configured.

historianModel.description: Provider/model ID used for historian compaction, for example lmxu/gpt-5.6-sol:high. Empty keeps historian inactive.

agentmemory.enabled.description: Opt in to the mctx-owned bridge for an unmodified agentmemory service.

agentmemory.url.description: Agentmemory service URL. AGENTMEMORY_URL overrides this value.

agentmemory.secret.description: Bearer secret for authenticating with the agentmemory service. AGENTMEMORY_SECRET overrides this value.

agentmemory.project.description: Explicit agentmemory project identity; Git root and cwd are fallbacks.

agentmemory.agentId.description: Optional agent tag. AGENT_ID overrides this value.

agentmemory.capture.description: Capture session, tool, and assistant observations.

agentmemory.inject.description: Admit automatic recall as a cache-stable Context Projection event after the triggering user entry. Disable for tool-first memory_search only.

agentmemory.memoryTools.description: Enable the bridge memory tool surface.

agentmemory.requireHttps.description: Fail closed when a bearer secret targets non-loopback plaintext HTTP.
